crossRefs.note: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.

translations.web: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.
translations.bsb: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as if I were aiming at a target.
translations.kjv: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
translations.asv: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
